text: Which legal entity or parent group should DataStrata assess?
whyAsked: Creates the legal scope anchor; internal business units cannot substitute.

text: Upload the latest annual report, audited financial statements and — if relevant — group chart. You may continue manually.
inputPath: OCR/document extraction (candidate facts only; confirmation required)
whyAsked: Pre-fills high-value facts but keeps them unconfirmed until reviewed.

text: Where is the entity incorporated, and what is its legal form?
whyAsked: Routes EU/non-EU scope and the legal-form perimeter.

text: What financial year are you assessing?
whyAsked: Determines threshold period, wave and deadlines.

text: Is the entity standalone, a parent undertaking, a subsidiary, a branch, or both a parent and a subsidiary?
whyAsked: Selects the individual, consolidated, exemption and third-country modules.

text: What is the ultimate parent's country and which EU legal entities or branches are in the group?
whyAsked: Distinguishes EU-parent, non-EU-parent and gateway paths.

text: What was this entity's net turnover for the relevant financial year? (Exact value or range.)
whyAsked: Tests the EUR 450m individual threshold.

text: What was the entity's average employee count during the financial year? (Exact value or range.)
whyAsked: Tests the 1,000-employee threshold.

text: What was the group's consolidated net turnover?
whyAsked: Tests consolidated turnover scope.

text: What was the group's average employee count on a consolidated basis?
whyAsked: Tests consolidated employee scope.

text: Was this entity required to report under CSRD for financial year 2024?
whyAsked: Identifies first-wave status and FY2025–26 transition questions.

text: Which Member State's accounting/reporting law governs this entity?
whyAsked: Selects national transposition, options, filing and publication rules.

text: Has the relevant Member State implemented the amended CSRD rules, and any FY2025–26 relief?
inputPath: System lookup (country pack) / analyst review — not a customer guess
whyAsked: Prevents an EU-level screen from becoming a false final legal conclusion.

text: Is the entity included in a parent's qualifying consolidated sustainability report?
whyAsked: Tests the central exemption condition.

text: Under which standard is the parent report prepared, and is it publicly available?
whyAsked: Tests standard and publication conditions.

text: If the parent is outside the EU: is the parent report assured, and are the required EU Taxonomy disclosures available?
whyAsked: Completes the non-EU-parent exemption path.

text: If this entity is itself a parent: is it included in a qualifying higher-parent consolidated report?
whyAsked: Tests the consolidated-duty exemption separately from the individual one.

text: Did the ultimate non-EU parent generate more than EUR 450m net turnover in the EU in each of the last two consecutive financial years? (Two separate values — never averaged.)
whyAsked: Tests the Article 40a group gate.

text: Does the group have an EU subsidiary with more than EUR 200m net turnover in the preceding financial year?
whyAsked: Tests the subsidiary gateway.

text: If no qualifying subsidiary exists: is there an EU branch with more than EUR 200m net turnover?
whyAsked: Tests the secondary branch gateway.

text: Have you received a sustainability-information request from a customer, lender or other counterparty?
whyAsked: Activates the indirect/value-chain module for entities outside direct scope.

text: Is the requestor subject to CSRD, and is the request specifically for its CSRD reporting?
whyAsked: The value-chain cap is purpose-limited.

text: What was your average employee count in the preceding financial year?
inputPath: Reuse profile fact or ask range/value
whyAsked: Tests protected-undertaking status (≤1,000 employees).

text: Upload the questionnaire or list the requested information items.
inputPath: OCR/LLM draft mapping + human confirmation against the versioned cap catalogue
whyAsked: Compares each item to the current versioned cap catalogue. GHG emissions metrics are outside the cap protection.

text: Did the request identify above-cap items and explain your right to decline?
whyAsked: Creates the requestor-side notice gap (G-014).

text: Would you like DataStrata to assess readiness against the obligations that apply?
whyAsked: Keeps applicability and execution separate.

text: Is the legal reporting perimeter documented and approved?
whyAsked: Creates the perimeter evidence gap.

text: Has the double-materiality process been designed, performed, approved and scheduled for refresh?
whyAsked: Creates a process-level materiality gap — never an AI materiality judgment.

text: Are board, management and data-owner roles documented with named accountability?
whyAsked: Creates the governance/ownership gap.

text: Is there an applicable process to consult workers' representatives and communicate their opinion?
whyAsked: Creates the consultation process gap.

text: Do you have an inventory of sustainability policies, actions, targets, metrics and source owners?
whyAsked: Credits existing work and identifies missing ownership.

text: How will material value-chain information be obtained or estimated?
whyAsked: Tests transition and steady-state data method.

text: Is the linked EU Taxonomy Article 8 workstream applicable and ready?
whyAsked: Routes to the linked Taxonomy module rather than hiding it.

text: Has an eligible assurance provider been appointed, and has the limited-assurance scope been agreed?
whyAsked: Creates the assurance runway gap.

text: Are sustainability evidence controls, review procedures and owners documented and tested?
whyAsked: Distinguishes a drafted report from an assurance-ready record.

text: Is a dedicated sustainability section incorporated into the statutory management-report template?
whyAsked: Creates the report-structure gap.

text: Can the report be produced in the currently required electronic format?
whyAsked: Creates the digital-format gap without inventing premature tagging obligations.

text: Is the national filing, publication, language, approval and assurance calendar documented?
whyAsked: Creates dated actions from national law.
